draw.title: Capsule Draw
draw.short: Pick a name or option at random
draw.tagline: A free random picker game for names and options
draw.description: Use this free online random picker to choose one name, number, lunch option, or other entry. Add the candidates and tap the machine crank to roll out one result. It works for giveaways, friendly bets, chores, presentation order, and quick decisions with no sign-up or installation.

ladder.title: Ladder Game
ladder.tagline: A free online ladder game for 2–6 players
ladder.description: Play a free online ladder game for 2–6 players. Add the outcomes, then tap each animal to trace its route and reveal the result. Use it for chores, presentation order, friendly bets, or assigning turns—no sign-up or installation required on mobile or desktop.

race.title: Animal Race
race.tagline: Choose the field size and go — a 3D race packed with lead changes
race.description: Choose two to seven distinct animals and watch them charge down a long track. The winner and motion curves are seeded first, giving every animal an equal chance.

fortune.title: Fortune Cookie
fortune.tagline: A free online fortune cookie for luck, courage, connection, or comfort
fortune.description: Open a free online fortune cookie and reveal a random message for today. Choose luck, courage, connection, or comfort, then tap the cookie once to crack it open. Get a new fortune on mobile or desktop with no sign-up or installation.

categories.aria: Choose the kind of message you need today

luck.label: Luck
messages: A small coincidence is about to lean in your favor.
The news you have been waiting for is closer than it seems.
A different route may bring a welcome surprise.
One lighthearted choice can start a lovely new rhythm.
Today's luck begins with the first hello.
Something you almost forgot may become unexpectedly useful.
Timing is on your side; take the first small step.
A modest hope may return as a much bigger smile.
Notice the first opportunity that catches your eye today.
Something good is quietly making its way toward you.
A choice made on a whim may be exactly right today.
Something familiar will shine in a completely new way.
A tiny task you postponed may bring unexpected luck.
Today's good momentum will grow clearer in the afternoon.
A casual suggestion may turn into a delightful plan.
The answer you need is already closer than it seems.
A pocket-sized bit of luck is traveling with you today.
Look once more where you already searched for a welcome chance.
Let your favorite color guide one choice today.
An unexpected compliment will brighten the direction of your day.
The moment that feels late may actually be perfect timing.
A little curiosity will lead to a delightful discovery.
The first smile you receive today is a lucky signal.
A pleasant twist is hiding inside an ordinary choice.
What you need will arrive more naturally than expected.

courage.label: Courage
messages: You do not have to wait until everything feels perfect.
One small start today will become tomorrow's confidence.
Trust your curiosity one more time than your hesitation.
There is strength in the first clear answer you imagined.
Look for the next possible step, not the whole difficult climb.
It is okay to be wrong; movement reveals the next scene.
Say the thing you have been holding back, even briefly.
If it feels a little scary, it may matter a lot.
One honest attempt is stronger than an old worry.
You are ready enough. All that remains is pressing start.
Even a quiet voice can carry a clear and honest heart.
You are already one step stronger than you were yesterday.
An unknown road gets easier after the first corner.
Courage is not fearlessness; it is a heart that still moves.
Begin the heavy task with its smallest possible piece.
Give your own choice one honest vote of confidence.
One sentence spoken now can end a long hesitation.
Being new and imperfect is a wonderful look on you.
A small attempt now is closer than the next perfect chance.
Lift your head and you may notice someone ready to help.
Choose a joyful challenge over safe perfection today.
Use the energy spent imagining failure to picture success too.
You are allowed to be the first person to applaud yourself.
A slow choice that keeps moving will eventually win.
Your first step may become someone else's courage too.

relationship.label: Connection
messages: A passing comment from someone close may hold the clue.
The person who checks in first may create today's best connection.
A small kindness will be remembered longer than you expect.
Listening well may bring you closer than finding the perfect reply.
A welcome message could brighten an ordinary day.
Send a short note to the person who just came to mind.
One honest laugh can melt an awkward moment.
The person who lets you relax may point you in a good direction.
An old connection may show you a new side today.
Open your heart a little and a warm answer may return.
Someone you can laugh with will feel closer today.
Naming what you appreciated will deepen a relationship.
One short question can untangle a misunderstanding.
There is someone who understands your comfortable silence.
Today's meeting will last longer if you do not rush it.
A small kindness offered first will return as a warm reply.
A familiar friend may introduce an exciting new connection.
One shared taste will open an unexpectedly good conversation.
A different opinion may reveal something charming in both of you.
Simply saying someone's name can feel beautifully warm today.
A quiet relationship may find its good rhythm again.
Your sincere encouragement may change someone's whole day.
A short meal together can bring you closer than a long talk.
Tell the person who made you smile what they gave you.
A good connection sends comfortable signals without force.

comfort.label: Comfort
messages: You are allowed to be gentler with yourself today.
A slower pace is enough when the direction feels right.
Rest is part of moving forward.
Set down anything that does not need to be solved today.
Today's mistake may become tomorrow's charming story.
A quiet breath can make more room than you expect.
You deserve a small compliment for making it through today.
When your mind feels crowded, do the easiest thing first.
You do not need to find every answer today.
Your pace is not late; it is the pace that fits you.
Today's tiredness is proof of effort, not laziness.
Pausing now does not erase any step you have already taken.
Even warm water can soften the edges of a hard day.
When thoughts feel crowded, let your body rest first.
Notice the heart that endured, not only what went imperfectly.
A peaceful evening is a good enough plan for today.
Weather passes through the heart too; do not blame today's clouds.
You have protected far more than you have missed.
Time spent doing nothing can still be busy healing you.
Fold the worry away briefly and play a song you love.
You need kindness before advice today.
Slow breathing will help your thoughts find their places again.
It is okay to leave today's unfinished work to tomorrow's you.
Tell yourself you did well for carrying the small discomforts.
Resting never makes you less worthy or less complete.
